subject: FintechCo - Post-demo performance recap & SLO checklist
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@fintechco.com>
Cc: Sally Park <sally@fintechco.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: FintechCo - Post-demo performance recap & SLO checklist

Hi Tom / Sally,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today — appreciate the thoughtful questions. Per our conversation, I wanted to summarize the performance targets you called out and propose next steps (attached SLO checklist + demo perf PDF). This should help us scope a short technical POC and an internal MAP (mutual action plan).

Key SLOs you mentioned during the call:
- Latency: P95 target <= 300ms for text-generation responses (end-to-end, app -> Redwood -> client).
- Throughput: baseline 500 requests/sec with spikes to ~1k req/sec for batch billing windows.
- Concurrency: concurrent sessions expected ~40-60 active user streams; target planning 50 concurrent streams.
- Streaming: must support chunked streaming to the browser; partial tokens should arrive within 100ms of generation.
- Token-rate / budget: estimated 40M tokens/day at current pilot workload (we'll provide more precise numbers if you share sample traffic).

Proposed next steps:
1) FintechCo to confirm any additional hard SLOs by EOD Friday (latency/throughput/concurrency).
2) Redwood to run an internal perf run against a production-like config and share a perf report (attached) + quantization profile suggestions.
3) Technical POC: 2-week window where Redwood devs and Fintech eng work through 3 MAP items: streaming integration, prefix caching for repeated prompts, and failover policy to a lower-cost variant.
4) Legal / procurement: we can surface initial pricing guidance once we lock SLOs.

I've attached a quick SLO checklist (one-pager) and the demo perf report. Let me know if you want me to invite our infra lead (Aditya) and runtime engineer (Dylan) to a technical deep-dive next week — we can run a focused session on streaming + batching tradeoffs.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: fintechco_slo_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
Attachment: demo_perf_report.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sally Park <sally@fintechco.com>, platform@fintechco.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FintechCo - Post-demo performance recap & SLO checklist

Marissa — thanks for the write-up and for sending the attachments. Quick clarifications from our side after an internal sync: 

- Latency: P95 <= 300ms is what we want in our SLIs. However, for streaming endpoints we'd be OK with P95 of the first token at ~150ms and subsequent tokens streaming at <100ms per chunk.
- Throughput: 500 req/sec is the baseline. The 1k spike is right — that happens during settlement end-of-day (about 10–15 minutes). We also want an SLA on sustained throughput for windows of up to 1 hour.
- Concurrency: 50 concurrent is a good planning number. If you can design for 75 headroom that would be ideal for the pilot scale.
- Rate-limits & throttling: we need graceful 429 behavior and a clear retry/backoff recommendation for client-side code.

Two asks for your perf run:
1) Can you simulate the ~10–15 minute 1k spike with streaming enabled (we'll provide a sandbox dataset of representative prompts)?
2) Please outline the fallback model variants and the expected degradation characteristics (latency increases, token drop, hallucination risk) in the perf report.

If you can get the perf run and updated checklist by next Wednesday (7/7), we'll circulate to procurement + infra for quick review. Also happy to do a 30-minute technical call — Wed or Thu next week — to align on the POC plan.

Thanks,
Tom Nguyen
Head of Platforms
FintechCo

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@fintechco.com>
Cc: Sally Park <sally@fintechco.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FintechCo - Post-demo performance recap & SLO checklist

Thanks Tom — that's helpful and aligned with our thinking. We'll schedule the perf run with streaming enabled and include the 10–15 minute spike scenario. A few notes and commitments: 

- Perf run scope: 1) steady-state 500 req/sec for 1 hour, 2) 15-minute spike to 1k req/sec with 50–75 concurrency, streaming enabled, 3) 30-minute sustained 800 req/sec window to test autoscaling.
- Measurements we'll produce: p50/p95/p99 end-to-end latency, first-token latency for streaming, per-token latency, CPU/GPU utilization, queueing depth, and error/429 rates.
- Fallback variants & degradation note: We'll include two fallback variants (quantized 8-bit and a smaller architecture variant) with documented latency and quality deltas and an estimated hallucination risk score for each using our eval heuristics.
- Client guidance: will provide recommended retry/backoff (exponential with jitter), recommended client-side concurrency caps, and a streaming chunk-size suggestion to meet your first-token latency requirements.

Action items and owners:
- Tom / FintechCo: share sandbox prompts and expected token distribution by EOD Friday (7/2).
- Redwood (Aditya + Dylan): run perf scenarios and share the updated perf_report + SLO checklist by Wed 7/7.
- Schedule: I'll send a calendar invite for a 30-min technical alignment for Wed 7/7 10:00am PT — if that doesn't work we'll move to Thu.

Happy to loop in our runtime lead if deeper kernel-level tuning is needed after the initial perf run.

Best,
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: FW: FintechCo - Post-demo performance recap & SLO checklist

Quick internal note — forwarding the thread above and the attachments.

Summary for infra run (owner: Aditya)
- Run three perf scenarios: steady 500 req/s (1h), 15-min spike to 1k req/s with streaming, 30-min 800 req/s sustained. Include 50–75 concurrency in spike.
- Capture: p50/p95/p99, first-token streaming latency, per-token latency, GPU util, queue depths, error rates.
- Produce: updated demo_perf_report.pdf and fintechco_slo_checklist.xlsx with explicit row for fallback model variants + quality deltas.

Dylan: please include recommendations for batching, prefix caching, and streaming chunk sizes — the Fintech team is sensitive to first-token latency.

Let me know if you need any more context before the Wed run.

-Marissa
